business_problem: Bricorama wanted to help DIY customers make better painting decisions online, but shoppers often struggled to choose colors, estimate quantities, and visualize results confidently without expert guidance or a seamless link into ecommerce.
solution_summary: Bricorama and Accenture built pAInt as a generative AI shopping assistant for paint-selection and project-planning workflows. The platform runs on Azure OpenAI Service and uses ChatGPT capabilities for natural-language conversation, letting shoppers describe their projects and receive guidance on color choices, quantities, tutorials, trends, and similar examples. Accenture and Bricorama trained the assistant on proprietary content such as paint-can labels and product information so recommendations stay tied to the retailer's available inventory instead of generic advice. The experience is integrated with Bricorama's ecommerce systems, allowing users to save projects to their profiles and add recommended products directly to wishlists or baskets. The implementation also includes responsible-AI safeguards that constrain responses to painting and home-improvement topics and keep the service aligned with GDPR.

data_flow: Customers describe a painting project to pAInt, which uses Azure OpenAI Service and ChatGPT capabilities together with Bricorama's proprietary paint and product content to generate recommendations. The assistant returns color suggestions, quantities, and related advice, then passes product choices into Bricorama's ecommerce flows so items can be saved to profiles, wishlists, or baskets for later purchase.
business_outcome: Bricorama improved shopper confidence and engagement, created a new advisory channel tied directly to commerce, and strengthened brand loyalty by helping customers move from project questions to product selection more easily.
metrics: 20% of users completed three pAInt experience modules
